scope: One current select helper Injector source-use role; the prior review and wrapper are preserved as historical evidence.
semantic_review: The old wrapper checked only summary counts and nonqualification flags. The successor always captures a report, validates all ten expected line/mode/production rows and every expected mutation ID and rejection, checks aggregate counts against the report, preserves the nonqualification checks, and cleans up a temporary report when one is not requested. It adds no product behavior or public API claim.

select_wrapper.command: CLOSEOUT_SELECT_RENDER_REPORT=<external report> python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_select_render_runtime.py

limits: The test is a source-member replay with protocol collaborators; it does not qualify actual legacy component DI, native browser rendering, packed artifacts, supported runtime floors or G11.
Other source-use roles, security holds and the global TOOL planner are not qualified by this successor.
